name: Getsuji Payroll
description: Getsuji Payroll is a calm, photographic WordPress landing theme designed for independent payroll bureaus and accountancy practices. Built for small business services, it features framed full-bleed imagery, hairline editorial typography, and structured fee tables that present monthly closing cycles with clarity. The clean aesthetic pairs Figtree and Manrope typography with refined offset grid accents to establish immediate professional trust.
